scope: Full original counts, fresh processes, default V8 tiering; setup excluded and final predicate included.

rust_contract.name: quicksort
rust_contract.setup_excluded: read/parse input and generate one vector with original six-component f64 combined multiple-recursive RNG
rust_contract.timed: 2500 full vector clones and original crossing-swap/restoration partition with smaller-first recursion; final sortedness walk before clock capture
rust_contract.representation: packed Vec<i64> values/native recursion versus generic Scheme vectors/exact-integer representation; original f64 RNG state/algorithm retained; allocation/reclamation differ
rust_contract.opacity: black_box full vector clone and mutable sort input; no full-result audit inside timing
rust_contract.audit: small complete vector plus independent library-sort/native tests; canonical sortedness predicate
rust_contract.ignored_input: last datum ignored is ignored in both systems
